two_undo_backends.backend_A: CommandBus ring buffer — RingBufferUndoStack (packages/runtime-undo-stack), pushed at packages/command-bus/src/CommandBus.ts:591 on every successful dispatch that produced patches. Inverse Immer patches are applied through apps/editor/src/engine/undo/elementUndoStoreAdapter.ts.
two_undo_backends.backend_B: Legacy commandManager history — each packages/command-registry/src/**/*Command.ts carries its own undo(); pushed at CommandBus.ts:581 `this.undoStack.push(record)` and by the legacy commandManager itself.
two_undo_backends.single_entry_point: apps/editor/src/engine/undo/performUndoRedo.ts (C03 §4.6 U-5). Before it there were FOUR divergent triggers that did not agree on which stack to consult (SaveUndoRedoHUD, initUI Ctrl+Z, BimService.undo, ContextualEditBar).

which_verbs_use_which.backend_A_only: every PLAN-VIEW created element — every PlanToolHandler dispatches runtime.bus.executeCommand only, so a plan-created wall exists ONLY in the ring buffer.
which_verbs_use_which.BOTH (dual-dispatch): the 3-D tools — WallTool, Slab, Roof, Furniture, Plumbing, Stair, Handrail, Beam — dispatch the bus AND commandManager.execute(CreateXCommand), so a 3-D element is in BOTH stacks.
which_verbs_use_which.backend_B_only: levels, hosted door/window openings, auto room-tag annotations (named in performUndoRedo.ts:44-46). Also the founder-reported wall rake/rake/profile edits.

what_happens_AT_THE_SEAM: 1. RING-BUFFER FIRST, but only when the entry's affectedStores are ALL covered by the live store map. If not covered the cursor is deliberately NOT stepped (no desync) and it falls through to B.

2. SHADOW-DROP — after a successful ring-buffer undo, matching commandManager entries are dropped by target id (commandManager.dropEntriesForTargets), or the orphaned legacy CreateXCommand causes a PHANTOM second Ctrl+Z.
3. CROSS-STACK CHRONOLOGICAL ORDERING (§UNDO-CROSS-STACK-ORDER) — both stacks now carry commit timestamps and undo reverts the newest pending entry across both.

4. ⚠ THE SEAM'S OWN CORRECTION, still on the file: §UNDO-ORDERING-KEY / L-7300 (2026-08-23) records that 'missing timestamp ⇒ ring-buffer first' was not a fallback but THE ROUTING RULE, because SIX of the EIGHT production ring-buffer push sites minted entries with no timestamp (initBusHandlers.ts :825, :1596, :1647, :1703, :1798 and commitAnnotationSet.ts; only CommandBus.ts:591 and initBusHandlers.ts:1335 stamped one). RingBufferUndoStack.push() now stamps at push.

5. §UNDO-GESTURE-ID (C03 §4.6 U-10) — chronological ordering must not re-route a DUAL-DISPATCH TWIN; the old test was a wall-clock guess (|Δt| ≤ 250 ms), i.e. a property of the machine, not of the user's intent.
two_undo_backends.disposition: backend_B = REPLACE (target end state is ADR-0251: one store, derived geometry, one timeline). performUndoRedo.ts itself = KEEP-WITH-REASON.
two_undo_backends.evidence_class: (c) executed reads of performUndoRedo.ts, CommandBus.ts and the grep of bimManager/commandManager sites — plus (a) for the six-of-eight push-site figure, which is quoted from the file's own correction box and was NOT independently re-counted by this lane.

events_with_no_consumer.source: P1 measured NINE zero-subscriber CEB channels (census.json.channel_subscribers). This lane dispositions them; it does not re-derive the count.

rows.reason: This is one of only FOUR non-create cases in the entire 38-case CEB switch, and one of the THREE that are the bridge's ONLY update arm. Layer edits are a real user gesture with a real legacy store (SlabStore) that would need the relay. An emit with no listener here is a missing listener, not dead architecture.

Rooms DO reach the plan view — through the §FT-ROOM-PLAN DOM bridge on `bim-room-added` (initTools.ts:2941), driven by the LEGACY CreateRoomCommand. So this is not a missing listener; it is a SECOND, unused channel for a path that already works by another route. P1 also found the name collides with a same-named event on a DIFFERENT bus (packages/stores/src/aggregate-commands/roomCreate.ts:111) — a name collision is a reason to retire the name, not to subscribe to it.

C11 §11 records TWO create verbs for one family with opposite verdicts: `plumbing.createFixture` (legacy, works, reaches exports) and `plumbing.create` (DTO, zero subscribers repo-wide). The channel is the DTO verb's, and the DTO verb is the rival. Converge on one verb, then the channel is either needed or gone.

C11 §11 marks grid AUTHORED + DISPATCHABLE + UNREACHABLE — `'grid:tool'` is never activated and the 3-D grid reads a DIFFERENT store. The channel is downstream of a tool that never fires; wiring the channel alone would not help, so this row is WIRE-BLOCKED-ON the tool activation. Recording it as WIRE rather than REMOVE because the store, the verb and the case all exist.
C11 §11 says annotations render on their own layer but are carried by NO IFC/PDF/DXF surface. The channel is the natural relay for that.

C11 §11: AUTHORED + DISPATCHABLE + UNREACHABLE — `DimensionTool` is not exported from the plugin barrel, so nothing can dispatch dimension.create in production. An emit downstream of an undispatchable verb is dead architecture until the barrel export lands; if the barrel export lands, re-mint the channel with a subscriber in the same commit.

Re-measured 2026-08-31: `grep -rn 'new StructuralCommitter(' apps packages plugins --include=*.ts | grep -v node_modules | grep -vE '\.test\.|__tests__'` -> 0. The intended consumer class is exported from plugins/structural/src/index.ts:42 and constructed NOWHERE, tests included. This is dead architecture on both ends — an emitter with no listener AND a listener class with no constructor call.

TENTH_ROW_NOT_IN_P1s_NINE.why_it_belongs_here: The INVERSE defect, and P1's subscriber count cannot see it. §FT-WATER (initTools.ts:1943) subscribes to `water.created`, but `grep -n "case '" packages/runtime-composer/src/CommandEventBridge.ts` lists 38 cases and there is NO `case 'water.create'`. A LISTENER FOR A CHANNEL WITH NO OWN-NAME EMITTER. Water reaches the screen only because it is emitted from inside `case 'pool.create'`. Counting subscribers per emitted channel structurally cannot find this class; it needs the set difference in the other direction.
TENTH_ROW_NOT_IN_P1s_NINE.disposition: KEEP-WITH-REASON — water is a STORE_ONLY member of the pool compound and has no independent create verb by design (ADR-0124). The reason must be written at the subscription site; today it is not.
